item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 01/Aug/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A southerly airstream will bring a few showers to the coast of Guangdong today. Under the influence of an anticyclone aloft, the weather will become fine and persistently very hot over southeastern China in the next few days, but there will still be one or two showers.

Date/Month: 01/08 (Thursday)
Wind: South to southwest force 3 to 4, occasionally force 5 offshore at first.
Weather: Sunny periods and a few showers. Hot during the day.
Temp range: 27 - 32 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium Low
